summary: Feed s115_double to IDS is degraded: 14.8% of frames exceed IDS 1518B MTU (up to 8058B) and are dropped by NIC, plus 9.6% duplicates waste capacity. IDS needs full payload and both directions.

findings.root_cause: Network carries jumbo frames (up to 8058 bytes) while IDS port max is 1518 bytes and packet broker is forwarding them unchanged without slicing or MTU handling.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS NIC drops 331/2230 frames (14.8%) before inspection, creating blind spot for large-frame attacks and breaking detection for that traffic; needs_full_payload=true so loss is critical.

options: enable 9000B jumbo on IDS NIC if supported
or configure broker to slice to 1518B

recommended_fix.why: Tool cannot receive >1518B frames; either enable jumbo support on IDS to keep full payload for detection, or slice at broker to at least deliver headers if jumbo not possible.

findings.root_cause: Same packets arriving via two SPAN/TAP paths aggregated to one tool port without broker deduplication; 214 of 2230 packets (9.6%) seen twice, above 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes cycles re-inspecting duplicates, inflates flow/alert counts, skews analytics and can mask true rate limiting; reduces effective 1Gbps capacity.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker deduplication to drop second copy within short window before delivery to IDS, preserving single correct copy for stateful inspection.
